mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity; rizatriptan as a 5-HT1B/1D agonist and phenelzine as an MAOI, creating a severe risk for serotonin syndrome.
action: Contraindicated combination; phenelzine must be discontinued at least 14 days before starting rizatriptan, or rizatriptan must be avoided entirely in patients on MAOIs.
